nodes.establishes: OpenAI's Usage Policies prohibit many potential harmful usages of our services (e.g., spamming and scamming), some of which are not specifically addressed by the Model Spec; these violations are difficult to address at the level of model behavior because they are about how content is used after it is generated, and are primarily addressed at a system level.
